title: Three vacuum-sealed packs of cylindrical samples on a concrete floor
objects_and_counts: Twelve visible cylindrical samples arranged as three separate vacuum-sealed plastic packs; each pack contains four cylinders arranged in a 2-by-2 grid (three packs × four cylinders = 12 cylinders visible).
Top pack (grey cylinders) is vacuum-sealed in transparent plastic and sits nearest the top of the image.
Middle pack (blue-green/teal cylinders with surface wear) is vacuum-sealed in transparent plastic and lies centrally in the image.
Bottom pack (light grey cylinders) is vacuum-sealed in transparent plastic and lies nearest the bottom of the image.
One partial shoe visible in the top-right corner of the image (cropped; only the sole/side visible).
One white perforated plastic bin or basket visible and cropped at the top-left corner of the image.
The background surface is a stained concrete floor covering the full image area.
spatial_relations: The three vacuum-sealed packs are stacked vertically with some gap between them: a grey pack at the top, a blue-green pack in the middle, and a light-grey pack at the bottom.
Within each pack, the four cylinders are arranged in a 2-by-2 grid so that two cylinders are adjacent horizontally and two vertically.
The partial white perforated bin is located outside the top-left edge of the top pack and is cropped by the image border.
The partial shoe is located outside the top-right edge of the image, adjacent to the top pack and cropped by the image border.
All packs rest directly on the concrete floor; no shelving or tables are visible.
colours_and_materials: Top pack cylinders are medium grey with a slightly polished or dusty surface.
Middle pack cylinders are blue-green / teal with white surface abrasion or residue visible.
Bottom pack cylinders are light grey with a matte finish.
All three packs are enclosed in transparent vacuum-seal plastic that produces highlights and creases over the cylinders.
Floor is a beige-to-brown stained concrete with visible scuffs and darker spots.
uncertainties: The exact wording on the top-row cylinders appears as '80 FA' on two visible positions; portions of top-pack handwriting may be partially obscured by reflections from the vacuum-seal film.

Some handwritten labels are partly obscured by plastic creases or angle; counts given are of clearly distinguishable cylinder faces visible in this single image and do not assert unseen items outside the frame.
The label transcriptions 'AAS' and 'OPC' are repeated on multiple cylinders; handwriting style and occlusion make it possible that small adjacent characters are present but unreadable.
The partial shoe and plastic bin are cropped and not fully visible; their exact types and counts beyond the cropped portions cannot be determined from this image.
